title: Optimal Experiments for Partial Causal Effect Identification
abstract: arXiv:2605.06993v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal queries are often only partially identifiable from observational data, and experiments that could tighten the resulting bounds are typically costly. We study the problem of selecting, prior to observing experimental outcomes, a cost-constrained subset of experiments that maximally tightens bounds on a target query. We formalize this as the max-potency problem, where epistemic potency measures the worst-case reduction in bound width guaranteed by an experiment, and show that this problem is NP-hard via a reduction from 0-1 knapsack. Building on the polynomial-programming framework of Duarte et al. (2023), we give a general procedure for evaluating epistemic potency in discrete settings. To control the super-exponential search space, we introduce two graphical pruning criteria that depend only on the causal graph and the query: a novel path-interception rule that exploits district structure to certify zero potency in linear time

translated_title: 部分因果效应识别的最优实验设计
translated_abstract: 因果查询往往无法仅从观测数据中完全识别，而能够收紧识别界限的实验通常代价高昂。我们研究在观察实验结果之前，选择一个成本受限的实验子集以最大程度收紧目标查询界限的问题。我们将其形式化为“最大效力问题”，其中认识效力衡量一个实验在最坏情况下所能保证的界限宽度缩减量，并通过从0-1背包问题的归约证明该问题是NP难的。基于Duarte等人（2023）的多项式规划框架，我们给出了在离散设置中评估认识效力的通用程序。为控制超指数级的搜索空间，我们引入了两个仅依赖于因果图和查询的图剪枝准则：一种新颖的路径拦截规则，它利用区域结构在线性时间内证明实验的零效力。
tldr: 该论文提出“最大效力问题”这一新框架，用于在成本约束下选择最优实验组合以最大程度收紧部分可识别因果查询的界限，证明了该问题的NP难性，给出了评估认识效力的通用方法，并引入基于因果图结构的剪枝准则（如线性时间的路径拦截规则）来控制超指数级搜索空间。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the max-potency problem of selecting a cost-constrained subset of experiments that maximally tightens bounds on partially identifiable causal queries, proves its NP-hardness via reduction from 0-1 knapsack, provides a general procedure for evaluating epistemic potency in discrete settings, and introduces graphical pruning criteria—including a linear-time path-interception rule exploiting district structure—to tame the super-exponential search space.
